title: The zine, in the box
logline: The zine from Gully's counter in Box 34 on top of the summer's pages, still closed, its crab up. He kept it and didn't read it. The page keeps it closed too.

panels.composition: An open cardboard box on a drafting table with a small stapled zine lying closed on top of a stack of drawn pages, a crab on its cover, lamplight.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an open cardboard box on a drafting table with a small stapled zine lying closed on top of a stack of drawn pages with a crab on its cover, lamplight, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
